tasks.short: Establish and work within the actual makeup budget

steps.what: Read the actual production requirements, current product quotes, labour/material needs and recorded spending; establish explicit item and cost-period mapping
inputs: Actual product prices and labour/material needs
outputs: Read original cost sources with explicit item/period mapping and unresolved prices

steps.what: Choose the actual product quantities, labour allowances and makeup priorities within the production's known budget constraints
inputs: Actual requirements and cost sources from s1
outputs: Artist-selected quantities, allowances and budget priorities

steps.what: Calculate fixed quantity-times-price totals and compare actual mapped spending with the selected budget, leaving unknown costs separate
outputs: Draft budget totals, actual-spend variance and unresolved costs

steps.what: Actually review budget pressure during the work and choose practical makeup/material adjustments within existing authority without treating a calculated variance as an instruction
outputs: Artist's actual within-budget work choices and unresolved funding issues

steps.what: Write and check the actual working budget and rationale, verifying selected quantities, original prices and real spending against the complete calculation
outputs: Complete checked actual working budget and stated limitations

steps.what: Save the actual working budget in the same spreadsheet workspace
inputs: Complete checked working budget from s5
outputs: Stored actual working budget

tasks.design: Calculate fixed budget totals and actual-spend comparisons in {SPREADSHEET} from actual mapped {ERP}/{PROJECT} records. Retain quantity/priority choices, real budget discipline and complete working-budget writing/checking; no model authorises spending.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual quantities, quotes and spending may be repeatedly totalled and compared manually.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit cost-item/period mapping permits fixed arithmetic and visible unknown costs.
tasks.still_hard: Creative requirements, performer needs and realistic material allowances require the makeup artist.
tasks.human_edge: The artist chooses how to deliver the look within actual constraints.

ambition.what: Establish and monitor the actual working budget with less repeated calculation.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; confirm actual quote/spend access with the production and financial owners

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact quantity/price and spend/budget comparisons are deterministic; no measured theatrical-makeup saving is asserted.

assumptions: s1 counts actual source reading, cost capture and item/period mapping, while s2 counts real quantity and allowance selection. No clean production-cost feed is invented.

Baseline100 retained75 gross25 minus3 new mapping upkeep gives22; unmeasured task-work estimates independent of the prior. Use existing spreadsheet formulas/native financial reports first; their current runtime earns no new saving.

The working budget is actual authored content, not a formal funding approval, purchase order or payment. Any real budget adoption or spending commit has its existing final-version authority and separate gated action; none is hidden in s4/s6.
The same-system save is negligible minimum share1, fully retained, ungated and without author self-approval.
unknowns: Native actual-spend reports and cost mapping
research_questions: Trace actual quantity choice, price capture, totals, budget judgment and real written budget separately.

already_counted.description: Original cost reading/capture, actual quantities and budget choices, whole-budget writing/checking and ordinary save

incremental.description: Maintain actual cost-item/period mappings and check calculation changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High:25 calculation/comparison points removed minus3 upkeep=22. Low: the existing financial report already performs18 of25 points, which earn no new benefit; only7 observed manual cross-item points remain eligible minus3 upkeep=4. Source capture, quantity choices, budget judgment, actual writing and save remain fully retained.

tasks.short: Write makeup sheets and photograph actual looks and products

steps.what: Actually take the necessary photographs of the completed specific makeup look, choosing views and lighting that preserve the visible result
outputs: Actual photographs of the specific look

steps.what: Identify and capture the actual products, shades, application details, performer/look identity and photograph associations used for this look
outputs: Actual captured product/look/photo metadata with explicit sheet-field mapping

steps.what: Populate repeated makeup-sheet identity/product fields and place the exact selected photograph references from the actual captured mapping
inputs: Actual metadata and explicit mapping from s2
outputs: Draft sheet fields with exact photo associations and missing fields flagged

steps.what: Write the actual makeup sheet's application, placement and continuity detail needed to reproduce the specific look
outputs: Actual written makeup-sheet instructions for the documented look

steps.what: Check the complete sheet and actual photos against the actual look and products, correcting wrong shades, associations or application details
outputs: Complete checked makeup sheet and associated actual photographs

steps.what: Save the checked makeup sheet and associated photos in the same existing look-record workspace
inputs: Complete checked sheet/photo set from s5
outputs: Stored actual look/product documentation

tasks.design: Use fixed {DOCS} makeup-sheet fields to reuse actual captured product/look/photo identities. Retain actual photography, original product capture, application-detail writing and complete checking; {OTHER} means the camera, actual products and the actual performer look.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual product identities and photo references can be recopied into the same structured makeup-sheet fields.
tasks.enabler_now: An explicit mapping and existing sheet template can populate those exact repeated fields without inferring shades or technique.
tasks.still_hard: Photos can misrepresent colour and a field list does not capture the actual placement or application method.
tasks.human_edge: The artist records what was truly used and what another artist needs to reproduce the look.

ambition.what: Document the actual look with less duplicate field handling.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3; confirm actual performer-photo permission and look-record access with their owners

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact captured metadata can populate a makeup-sheet template; actual photographs and application detail require the artist.

assumptions: Actual photography and source/product capture are counted in s1/s2 before any field population. Product use is not inferred from a face photo, and file associations are explicitly captured rather than assumed clean.

This creates the actual written sheets and photographs requested, not a substitute abstract summary. Existing template/auto-fill functions already used earn no new gain;15 points applies only to observed repeated manual field handling.
Baseline100 retained85 gross15 minus3 new mapping/template upkeep gives12; unmeasured task-work estimates independent of the prior.

The negligible same-system save is minimum share1, fully retained, ungated and without author self-approval. It does not publish performer photos, send them to a client or issue an operative crew instruction; any actual such action needs its own real final-version authority and separate gated step.
unknowns: Actual native sheet auto-fill and photo metadata
research_questions: Observe actual photo capture, product/shade capture, repeated sheet fields and real application-detail writing separately.

already_counted.description: Actual photography, original product/association capture, real makeup-sheet writing, complete checks and ordinary save

incremental.description: Maintain exact product/look/photo field mappings and test template changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High:15 exact repeated-field points removed minus3 upkeep=12. Low: imported photos lose look/performer identity metadata and require10 of15 field/association points to remain manual;5 removed minus3 upkeep=2. Actual photographs, product capture, application writing, complete checks and save stay fully retained.

tasks.short: Assess the actual performer's skin and makeup-compatibility concerns

steps.what: Locate and read the actual performer's existing relevant skin/product-response information through the native performer-record view
inputs: Existing relevant performer information and permitted access
outputs: Read original relevant history with its actual date and uncertainties

steps.what: Actually ask the performer about current skin concerns and previous product reactions, clarifying uncertainty without treating silence as evidence of compatibility
inputs: Actual performer and relevant history from s1
outputs: Actual performer-reported concerns, responses and uncertainties

steps.what: Actually assess the performer's skin appearance and condition for the intended makeup, considering current responses and referring unresolved concerns through the existing appropriate route
outputs: Artist's actual skin assessment and unresolved makeup-compatibility concerns

steps.what: Write and check the actually required relevant performer-record entry, separating reported reactions, observed condition and unresolved concerns
outputs: Checked factual relevant skin/response entry

steps.what: Save the factual entry in the same performer record
outputs: Stored relevant actual performer information

tasks.design: Configure existing relevant performer-history lookup in {OPS_SYSTEM}, retaining actual conversation, skin assessment and separate factual record writing. {OTHER} means the actual performer and in-person assessment; no model judges skin images or guarantees product compatibility.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant actual product-response history may require navigation in the performer record.
tasks.enabler_now: A native performer-linked view may reduce retrieval while preserving original dates and wording.
tasks.still_hard: Current skin condition and the meaning of reported reactions require direct assessment and acknowledgment of uncertainty.
tasks.human_edge: The artist hears the performer and observes the actual current condition.

ambition.what: Ease relevant-history lookup without automating skin assessment.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3; confirm actual permission and limited relevant-record access with the performer-record owner

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a native performer-history view can aid retrieval; it cannot guarantee that makeup causes no reaction.

assumptions: This actual episode has an existing relevant performer record and required factual update. Do not invent a new health dossier or note after every conversation. Original history reading, direct answers, current assessment and actual record writing are all counted.

This is assessment, not product application, a skin test, medical diagnosis or a treatment recommendation. If an actual subsequent physical test/application or written referral occurs, count its real work, current authority and separate action rather than hiding it here.
Baseline100 retained99 gross1 minus0.3 new view upkeep gives0.7; unmeasured task-work estimates independent of the prior. Already used native history access earns no new gain.

The ordinary same-system save is negligible minimum share1, fully retained, ungated and without author self-approval. Native record templates are considered without an unsupported note-writing saving.

Whether native performer-history links already exist

incremental.description: Keep relevant existing history links current without a second performer record

Conversation, current assessment, factual writing and save remain fully retained.
